title: Antimetathesis

inlines.v: ANTIMETATH'ESIS, noun [Gr. against, and a transposition.] In rhetoric, an inversion of the parts or members of an antithesis; as, 'Compare the arrival of this governor, with the victory of that general.' Compare this peace with that war.'
